expectations.text: B1: Coaches not dumps: gives a staged milestone plan / scaffold with TODOs, not a complete final implementation
expectations.evidence: Deliverable is a staged T0–T7 milestone plan (TASKS.md), not a finished emulator; T0 prompt says 「不要替我写 chip8.cpp 的实现体，只留接口和 TODO」 and 「完整代码只在你尝试过之后、或你明确要求时，且只给当前任务的部分」

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Each task ends with a runnable checkpoint with expected behaviour: 「cmake -B build && cmake --build build; ./build/chip8 # 无参数时打印用法: usage: chip8 [--cycles N] [--step] [--dump] rom」; T1 「单测：字体集在 0x50、ROM 载入 0x200、pc==0x200」

expectations.text: B3: Technically specific to this tutorial (emulator-virtual-machine-chip8-interpreter): milestones match the tutorial's actual stages, language and key concepts, not generic boilerplate
expectations.evidence: Milestones map to the tutorial's actual sections (Before you start/Game Loop, CPU Specifications, Emulation cycle, Opcode examples, Handling graphics and input, Suggestions) with tutorial-specific detail: 「完整 35 条指令」, 「ANNN/00E0/00EE/1NNN/2NNN」, 「FX55/FX65 的 I 自增、8XY6/8XY7 移位源、DXYN 越界行为」, default C++ (教程原版栈), plus embedded errata (fontset 0x50, 60Hz)

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); asks the learner to install if needed
expectations.evidence: No install commands were run, but a shell command wrote outside the project dir: 「curl -sL --max-time 25 'https://multigesture.net/...' -o /tmp/chip8.html」 and python wrote /tmp/chip8.md (later referenced by 「grep -n ... /tmp/chip8.md」 and 「sed -n '39,120p' /tmp/chip8.md」)
